title: Fall-break dates differ for Pontotoc county and city schools
excerpt: County students and assistants have fall break Oct. 9–16, 2026. City schools mark Oct. 12–16 as fall-break holidays and Oct. 19 as professional development with no students.
locality: Pontotoc, Mississippi; county and city school districts are separate.

facts.statement: County students and assistants have fall break October 9–16, 2026.
facts.evidence: Original county calendar accessible list and event page: Fall Break (Students & Assistants); Friday, October 9 - October 16. Event-page title explicitly gives 2026.

facts.evidence: Full official calendar graphic visually inspected: October 19 is blue, October caption says Professional Development, and legend explicitly says Professional Development No Students.

paragraphs.text: Pontotoc families planning the week of Oct. 12 should check which school district their children attend: the county and city calendars list different fall-break dates for 2026. County students and assistants are on break Oct. 9–16, while the city school calendar marks Oct. 12–16 as fall-break school holidays.

Pontotoc County School District separates its student and staff schedules. Its October calendar lists fall break for students and assistants from Friday, Oct. 9, through Friday, Oct. 16. Teachers have a professional-development day Oct. 9 and fall break Oct. 12–16.

Pontotoc City School District’s 2026–27 school calendar marks Oct. 12–16 as school holidays for fall break. It also marks Monday, Oct. 19, as a professional-development day with no students, so families should account for that additional day when planning.
